Gen. George S. Brown

Chairman · 1974–1978 · at the fall, 1975-04-30

Chairman on 30 April 1975. Had run the air war from Saigon in 1968–70; watched the end from the Tank.

The office

The Joint Staff, the Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia. The Chairman’s office is on the E-ring, second floor, river side; the Chiefs meet in the “Tank”, Room 2E924, and from 1972 in the Gold Room next to it.
